name: Bergen Open 2026
information: ### 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Bergen Open. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ##### Nye Deltakere Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2026#77513-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors). ##### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette er også helt gratis. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. --- ### 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to to Bergen Open! This competition is open to everyone who wants to compete. #### New Competitors There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2026#77513-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab. ##### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for free aswell. We still strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/bergenopen2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.
